items.title: Canada Tea Festival
items.summary: A celebration of culture, community, and connection, all through the simple joy of tea. Join us for a full day of tastings, workshops, and stories that bring together tea lovers from all walks of life.

items.title: Henna Workshop
items.summary: Discover the art of henna in this engaging, hands-on workshop led by artist Ankita Sherkhane. Participants will explore the rich cultural traditions and history of henna through a brief introductory presentation before learning the techniques behind creating their own unique designs. Using individual henna cones, attendees will have the opportunity to apply their creations to themselves or a partner and leave with a beautiful temporary henna tattoo (mehndi) that can be enjoyed for weeks afterward.

items.title: The Craft Show: presents The Fall Edit
items.summary: The Craft Show Fall Edit is an indoor curated market in the heart of Streetsville, Mississauga. Browse handmade goods from local artisans and specialty vendors, all under one roof. Free admission for everyone. Discover something special, you'll find unique pieces you won't see anywhere else.
items.venue: Streetsville Overseas Veterans' Club Royal Canadian Legion Branch 139

items.title: 2026 All Nations Powwow
items.summary: A Powwow is an Indigenous social celebration where community members can gather and enjoy traditional singing and dancing. All community members, including non-Indigenous, are welcome and strongly encouraged to attend and participate in what a Powwow has to offer. Experiencing a Powwow emphasizes the importance of relationship-building with everyone while providing opportunities to learn more about Indigenous culture and knowledge.

items.title: Food Forward Summit 2026
items.summary: Join the conversation shaping Canada's food future. Food Forward is Canada’s premier summit for food systems innovation. It brings together policymakers, innovators, producers, SMBs, community leaders, industry stakeholders, and ecosystem builders to advance the future of food through strategic dialogue, practical connections, and intentional collaboration. Innovation is the summit’s core focus. It shapes the purpose, programming, and value of the event.

items.title: The Art of Presence: Forest Bathing and Sound Immersion
items.summary: There is an art to slowing down, and most of us have forgotten it. Come be inspired by facilitator Tina De Luca in a two-hour immersive wellness experience inspired by the Japanese practice of Shinrin-yoku (forest bathing). The evening begins outdoors with a guided forest bathing experience around the grounds of the Small Arms Inspection Building. Through mindful walking and sensory awareness, you'll be invited to slow down, notice the natural environment, and reconnect with the present moment.
